## Workload

During the quarter, grader Hannah Lowe completed 341 reads over 273 hours. This represents a rate of 1.3 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review to support consideration of activity levels and the time required to complete the assigned reads.

## Quality

A sample of 30 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 46.7 per cent. The review identified borderline background cases, and feedback was provided to support consistent handling of these cases.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand.
